game_title: Countdown Launch – Dragon Hoard Cave Streak
game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave, a hoard-filled cave: the dwarf scout must handle rock golems while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Countdown Launch: Tick a countdown down each loop until it hits zero and the launch fires.
theme: Shadow Cave – Dragon Hoard Cave: a hoard-filled cave
core_gameplay_loop: In Dragon Hoard Cave, repeat each round: Tick a countdown down each loop until it hits zero and the launch fires. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the count value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about count to power up the dwarf scout and open the crystal door.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Countdown Launch
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how count changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against rock golems in Dragon Hoard Cave.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
